beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: A few weeks into the quiet, Riley's back, restless but trying not to show it.

beats.prompt: The past: the gentler strength that got you through the review.
The present: the turn that brought the offer, and the contract with it.
The future: the pause you're sitting in right now, whether you like it or not.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Quiz me on the new one. Does this mean signing was actually the wrong call, since now everything's just stopped?"

options.text: No — sometimes you sacrifice something now to gain something better later.
Yes, the pause proves it was a mistake.
This card has no opinion on the contract.

elaboration: Sometimes you sacrifice something now to gain something better later — the pause isn't proof the choice was wrong, it's part of the deal.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "If I'm not writing or recording or touring for six months, doesn't that mean I'm not actually growing?"

options.text: Stillness isn't nothing — it's meditative, and it deepens awareness even from here.
You're right, this whole stretch is wasted.

elaboration: Meditative stillness that deepens awareness — following the flow instead of fighting it is still movement, just not the kind you can see from the outside.

beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: "One thread ties all three: the strength that got you through it, the turn that brought the offer, and now, a pause you didn't ask for but might actually need."

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Yeah. I think I've been treating this like dead air, when it's really just the part of the song before the part that matters. I can sit in that for a while. Thanks."
